name: A Level Biology: Cellwright
subtitle: Practicals, quizzes & mocks
shortDescription: A personal tutor for A level biology: quizzes that learn what you miss, lab simulators, practical cards and mock papers.
longDescription:
A Level Biology: Cellwright adapts to you. Every answer you give updates a private model on your device, so the app shows what to revisit, which lab to run and what comes next, in plain words and with the reason why.

### Study Your Way
- Classical order follows the specification for A level biology (AQA 7402 structure, DfE subject content), covering 47 concepts from biological molecules to gene expression, plus topics that other boards add.
- The Real-World view, Investigate it, has you build things step by step: roll out a vaccine, engineer a stain-removing enzyme, restore a wetland, design a drought-ready crop, fuel an athlete, diagnose a patient case, breed a new variety, plan a gene therapy clinic, run a community health project. Each step teaches the idea it needs, then checks it, and finished builds go on your Made-it shelf.
- Switch between the Syllabus view and the Real-World view with one tap. Your progress is shared.

### Learn, Try, Check
- Short lessons with a worked example and the common slip, then a quick check with the reasoning explained.
- Six simulators: enzyme rates, water potential, potometer, dihybrid crosses with chi-squared, field sampling with Simpson's index and mark-recapture, and microscope graticule calibration.
- A practical logbook with 32 cards: the twelve AQA required practicals plus practicals and skills from Pearson, OCR and WJEC Eduqas. Choose variables, control the right factors, make it safe, evaluate.
- Unit tests, a cumulative test and 18 mock tests, including board-style papers for AQA, Pearson, OCR and Eduqas (shorter, multiple-choice adaptations; guide times shown), each with a report that links every miss to the lesson and a study plan.
- 2,113 original questions, each with a worked explanation, including 6-mark extended-response items with mark schemes. Calculated answers were checked by a second method.
- A Coverage screen lists 180 specification points drawn from the DfE subject content, AQA 7402, Pearson 9BN0 and 9BI0, OCR H420 and H422 and Eduqas, each with at least 8 practice questions, and your mastery on each. It shows practice coverage, not a grade promise.
- Optional Other boards chip on every lesson and a Curriculum map: see where a topic sits in GCSE, IB and AP.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
